overall: The AG found the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law: its 2025 executive sessions on pending litigation were proper under Purpose 3, minutes could still be withheld, and the records-request issue fell under the Public Records Law.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board convened in executive session for an improper purpose at meetings on Jan 15, Mar 19, and May 21, 2025.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the Board’s executive session discussions were appropriate under Purpose 3 because they related to pending litigation and a settlement agreement that was a proposed resolution to that litigation.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board continued to withhold executive session minutes from the Jan 15, Mar 19, and May 21, 2025 meetings after publication could no longer defeat their purpose.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the litigation matter discussed by the Board during the meetings held on January 15, March 19, and May 21, 2025, was still ongoing at the time of the records request, and is still ongoing, therefore the Board properly withheld the executive session minutes.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board did not properly respond to a records request for the executive session minutes, which was directed to the Town Clerk.
allegations.key_passage: As this allegation concerns compliance with the Public Records Law, it falls outside the scope of this office’s jurisdiction.
